name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA standard terms governing how two parties share and protect each other's confidential information.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA capturing the deal-specific terms: purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law and jurisdiction.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for selling and buying SaaS/cloud software, covering access, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper SLA defining target uptime, response times for support issues, and service credits when commitments are missed.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper DPA setting out processor/subprocessor obligations, security, international transfers and data subject rights for personal data (e.g. GDPR).

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement for early-stage product access in exchange for feedback from a design partner.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper PSA for engaging a provider to perform services under statements of work, including deliverables, IP and payment terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement for business partnerships, covering each party's obligations, feedback, trademark use, fees and confidentiality.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper HIPAA BAA governing how a provider may use, disclose and safeguard protected health information (PHI).

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement for licensing on-premise or downloadable software, covering license scope, restrictions, support, fees and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement for a time-limited trial or pilot of a product before a full commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper addendum to a software agreement addressing use of AI services, including inputs, outputs and model training on customer data.
